caveats: Requires the commandcode CLI on PATH, logged in via commandcode login.
Steering is rejected — the CLI has no live-turn channel.
Images work as of v0.1.4 but need a vision model: each is written to a temp file (max 16 MiB) that the model reads via `read_file`.
Effort levels vary per model; the Thinking selector is omit-by-default and models rejecting `--effort` are retried without it.
